set.name: Square Tube Corner Bracket
set.process: laser or waterjet cut plate, deburred, bolted assembly
set.design_notes: L-shaped flat bracket that bolts to the top faces of two 20x20 mm square tubes meeting at a right-angle corner (e.g. a frame corner). Leg width equals tube_size (20 mm) so each leg sits centered on a tube face. Each leg is leg_length long and carries 2 clearance holes (hole_d = 6.5 mm, for M6 bolts) for bolts into the tube wall (nut, rivet-nut, or self-tapping into the tube). Inner corner is filleted (corner_fillet_r) to relieve stress. Assumes light-duty framing load (e.g. furniture/cart frame); for heavy structural loads, increase plate_t or add a gusset.

set.design_notes: L-shaped flat bracket that bolts to the top faces of two square tubes (tube_size x tube_size) meeting at a right-angle corner. Leg width equals tube_size so each leg sits centered on a tube face. leg_length is derived as 3 * tube_size so there is always enough straight leg beyond the corner for two spaced fasteners; if you need a different leg length, set it directly instead of the expression. Each leg carries 2 slotted bolt holes: the outer slot sits hole_end_dist from the leg's far end, the inner slot's near edge sits hole_corner_margin beyond the corner (x = tube_size) so it never overlaps the perpendicular leg's slot. Slot width = hole_d (6.5 mm, M6 clearance); slot_play is the extra travel for position adjustment before final tightening. Bolts land in the tube wall via a nut, rivet-nut, or self-tapping screw. Inner corner is filleted (corner_fillet_r) to relieve stress. Assumes light-duty framing load; for heavy structural loads increase plate_t or add a gusset.

set.process: laser-cut flat pattern, press-brake formed: the two outer edges are bent 90 degrees to form the flanges
set.design_notes: L-shaped bracket formed from a single flat sheet: the flat L-shaped blank bolts to the top faces of two square tubes (tube_size x tube_size) meeting at a right-angle corner, and its two outer edges are bent 90 degrees down (bend_radius inside, bend_radius_outer outside, both derived from plate_t) to form flanges that wrap the outer side face of each tube, so bolts can go into a second face per tube. Leg width equals tube_size; leg_length and flange_height are derived from tube_size (3x and 2/3x respectively) so they stay proportional if tube_size changes. Each leg and each flange carries 2 slotted bolt holes (width hole_d = 6.5 mm for M6 clearance, slot_play of travel) positioned hole_end_dist from the far end and hole_corner_margin clear of the corner so slots never overlap. The reflex inner corner of the flat blank is filleted (corner_fillet_r) for stress relief, and the outer corners are broken (outer_corner_fillet_r) for safety. Assumes light-duty framing load; for heavy structural loads increase plate_t or add a gusset. Note: the two flanges meet at a closed/mitered corner post near the origin rather than a relief-cut flat pattern; fine for laser+brake with a corner weld or tight forming, but flag if a true flat-pattern relief cut is needed.

set.design_notes: L-shaped bracket formed from a single flat sheet: the flat L-shaped blank bolts to the top faces of two square tubes (tube_size x tube_size) meeting at a right-angle corner, and its two outer edges are bent 90 degrees down to form flanges that wrap the outer side face of each tube, so bolts can go into a second face per tube. The bracket is modeled as three unioned solids (plate + 2 flanges, each flange with a small miter-fill piece at the bend) that form one continuous, correctly connected part with a sharp (zero-radius) inside corner at each bend -- representative of a tight press-brake bend at this thickness. (An explicit inside bend-radius fillet was attempted but the fillet operation failed where it interacts with the plate's other corner fillets; the sharp bend is left in place rather than a broken/guessed fillet.) Leg width equals tube_size; leg_length and flange_height are derived from tube_size (3x and 2/3x respectively) so they stay proportional if tube_size changes. Each leg and each flange carries 2 slotted bolt holes (width hole_d = 6.5 mm for M6 clearance, slot_play of travel) positioned hole_end_dist from the far end and hole_corner_margin clear of the corner so slots never overlap. The reflex inner corner of the flat blank is filleted (corner_fillet_r) for stress relief, and the outer corners are broken (outer_corner_fillet_r) for safety. Assumes light-duty framing load; for heavy structural loads increase plate_t or add a gusset. The two flanges meet at a closed/mitered corner post near the origin (touching only along an edge, not sharing volume) rather than a flat-pattern relief cut; fine for laser+brake with a corner weld or tight forming.
